params.name: is-owned
params.description: Filters accounts based on whether they are owned by the authorised customer.  True for owned accounts, false for unowned accounts and absent for all accounts

params.name: oldest-time
params.description: Constrain the transaction history request to transactions with effective time at or after this date/time. If absent defaults to newest-time minus 90 days.  Format is aligned to DateTimeString common type

params.name: newest-time
params.description: Constrain the transaction history request to transactions with effective time at or before this date/time.  If absent defaults to today.  Format is aligned to DateTimeString common type

params.name: min-amount
params.description: Filter transactions to only transactions with amounts higher or equal to than this amount

params.name: max-amount
params.description: Filter transactions to only transactions with amounts less than or equal to than this amount

params.name: text
params.description: Filter transactions to only transactions where this string value is found as a substring of either the reference or description fields. Format is arbitrary ASCII string. This parameter is optionally implemented by data holders. If it is not implemented then a response should be provided as normal without text filtering applied and an additional boolean field named isQueryParamUnsupported should be included in the meta object and set to true (whether the text parameter is supplied or not)
